sources.label: Throwing patches at apps and seeing what sticks. 🧪
sources.author: andronedev
patch_list: Declare the screen where the AdMob credentials are entered.
Unlock every pro feature in AdMobile, in every process that checks for one.

Sign in with your own Google OAuth client, so the app talks to Google directly and to nobody else. No developer backend, no Firebase session, no third party holding your tokens or seeing your earnings, and no Google Sign-In that a re-signe…
